executive_summary: HOVE A/S reported challenging H1 2024 results with revenue declining 11% to DKK 85.7M and operating profit falling 46% to DKK 6.9M, driven by lower-than-expected sales. Despite operational headwinds, the company maintained a strong 73.1% solvency ratio and repaid DKK 3 million in high-interest debt as part of its strategic financial management focus.
key_highlights: Revenue decreased 11% year-over-year from DKK 96.3M to DKK 85.7M
Operating profit declined 46% from DKK 12.9M to DKK 6.9M
Cash position weakened 55% from DKK 8.8M to DKK 4.0M
Solvency ratio remained strong at 73.1% (up from 67.4%)
Inventory increased 30% to DKK 38.5M due to strategic build-up
Repaid DKK 3 million of high-interest debt during H1 2024
